known_limitations: PERCEPTUAL QUALITY IS NOT MEASURED. No listening test was run. Which decoder SOUNDS best is not established and no sentence may imply it (GATE4_PREREG SECTION 5.5, SECTION 2036).
mcd is gain-invariant by construction and blind to a pure level error; a mcd ranking never implies level fidelity.

Q9 FIRES: griffinlim, the zero-parameter floor, scores BEST on mcd in all six states. A metric cannot rank decoders on a quantity one of them optimises. Route A has no zero-parameter control, so the same validity check is NOT ESTABLISHED there.
Q5 measures SPEAKER-EMBEDDING RETENTION, not perceptual identity and not cloning quality. Cosine values are encoder-specific and are never averaged across encoders.
51,060 of 93,744 offline cells and 78,441 of 83,328 streamed cells fall outside mcd's validated support; support is carried as a covariate, never an exclusion.
Every FocalCodec DRIFT verdict rests on out-of-support cells (0-6 in-support cells per stratum, 50 strata with zero), so identity dispersion and band-limiting CANNOT be separated for that family.
ECAPA's own human cross-state ceiling sits near its impostor floor, so a cross-state APPROACHES IMPOSTOR RANGE marker on ECAPA or redimnet_b6_lm is an ENCODER BASELINE LIMITATION, not decoder drift.
7 speakers, one studio, one recording chain, English. Absolute values are not comparable to VoxCeleb-scale benchmarks.
Arms were driven streamed with chunked context several were not designed for; the claim is about streamed behaviour, not defect.
redimnet_b6_lm runs on CPU because it failed an exact-zero cross-process determinism probe on CUDA; CPU-vs-GPU cosine difference is <= 2.5e-04, ~100x below the smallest decision bound.
